fields.label: Check Point
fields.options:
Do you have an IMS objective? Please elaborate
Are you aware of our IMS Policy? Do you communicate this to your staff? How?
Do you understand the purpose and scope of this PD?
Did you receive a formal request for estimation from the Sales Department, Project Manager, or client?
Did you document the request using an Estimation Request Form, including all relevant project details?
Did the Estimations Manager (BD) review the request to ensure all necessary information is provided?
Did the Estimations Manager assign an Estimator to the project?
Did you collect detailed project specifications, drawings, and any other relevant documents?
Did you consult with project stakeholders to clarify requirements and assumptions?
Did you conduct a site visit?
Did you review historical data and previous project estimates for reference?
Did you identify any cost trends or recurring issues that may affect the current estimate?
Did you divide the project into manageable components or work packages?
Did you identify all cost elements, including materials, labor, equipment, subcontractors, and overheads?
Did you use standard estimation tools and software to calculate costs for each component?
Did you apply appropriate rates and factors, ensuring consistency with company standards and market conditions?
Did you collect supplier and service provider prices?
Did you assess potential risks and uncertainties associated with the project?
Did you include contingency allowances to cover unforeseen costs?
Did the estimator conduct a self-review of the prepared estimate for accuracy and completeness?
Did the estimator submit the estimate to the Estimations Manager for review?
Did the QA team review the estimate for compliance with quality standards and accuracy?
Did the QA team provide feedback and request revisions if necessary?
Did the Estimations Manager review the final estimate, incorporating QA feedback?
Did the Estimations Manager approve the estimate or request further revisions if needed?
Did you prepare the final estimate report, including detailed breakdowns and justifications?
Did you submit the estimate to the BDM or client as required?
Did you maintain detailed records of all estimation documents, including initial requests, data collected, calculations, and approvals?
Are the records stored securely and easily retrievable for future reference?
Did you gather feedback from project stakeholders on the accuracy and usefulness of the estimate?
Did you prepare a detailed project budget and get approval from Business Director in order to share it with the commercial and project team?
Did you analyze feedback and identify areas for improvement in the estimation process?
Did you implement changes to enhance accuracy and efficiency in future estimates?
